notes: The model identified 4 findings, all claiming reentrancy vulnerabilities. However, every function identified (claimWinnings, finalizeWithdraw, emergencyWithdrawLP, emergencyRefundTickets) uses the nonReentrant modifier, which prevents reentrancy attacks.
